detector.description: Alerts when k8s job has pods in failed phase for more than 90% of time in last 5 min
detector.name: K8s job with pod failed (%) > 90
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.autodetect.infra.k8s import job
job.job_fail_pct_high().publish('K8s job with pod failed (%) > 90')

rules.description: The value of k8s.job.failed_pods - Sum by k8s.cluster.name,k8s.namespace.name,k8s.job.name is above 90.
